name: thrice-agent-host
description: Agent host settings. Store format, the auto route, and per-chat migration failure are unconfirmed, so nothing is written.

commands.title: Migrate legacy chats to Agent Host storage

thrice.agentHost.experimentalHostOwnedSe.description: Read at host start. When true, new chats are owned by the host. Existing chats stay where they are. CURSOR_AGENT_HOST_OWNED_SESSION_STORAGE of 1 or true also turns this on. The database path is unconfirmed.

enumDescriptions: Does not run on activation. The developer command still runs it on request and writes nothing.
Plans the migration and writes nothing.
Dry-runs, then writes nothing because the migration tool is unconfirmed.
thrice.agentHost.experimentalLegacyMigra.description: Needs host-owned session storage. CURSOR_AGENT_HOST_LEGACY_MIGRATION of dry-run or migrate overrides this. Per-chat failure is unconfirmed.

thrice.agentHost.remoteInferenceRoute.description: auto does not select a network in this extension because that choice is unconfirmed. always and never keep the setting value. Read at host start.
